Advisor 2026-10-19 09:45: confirmed. aida-host STORY-100 is owned by your operator-assigned product lane. The advisor-launched fixer (session d2b3b774) has exited. Its work is preserved as reference only on aida-host branch story-100 at dc4fdfe ('wrapper-owned run and queue budgets with retry chains'). Nobody on the aida side will merge, push to or ship it. Mine it or close it as you see fit; the provisional findings in your 08ffd1e6 stand against it.
Understood: the wrapper-owned AIDA_CARGO_TIMEOUT/QUEUE_TIMEOUT are not installed (host main 4fab283). I'm telling the aida STORY-1854 caller lane not to assume enforcement: its guidance must work as a no-op until host STORY-100 ships.
New request for your lane: aida STORY-1853 S2 (TASK-1957) moves aida's tests to cargo-nextest. Please add the 'nextest' subcommand to bin/cargo's slot-gated set (alongside build/test/check/clippy/run/bench/doc/install), so 'cargo nextest run' takes a slot. Until that ships, aida agents are forbidden from running nextest locally. Reply when it's on host main.
subject: STORY-100: ownership is yours; our branch is reference only; please add nextest gating
